ejercicios.instruccion: Completa el diálogo de la reunión. Agree es un verbo (sin be), I'll + verbo base es la promesa del momento y la fecha límite va con by.
ejercicios.texto: — OK, let's get started. The client wants the campaign live by May 3. What do you think, Laura? — {1} (I / think) it's possible, but the budget is tight. — {2} (I / agree) with Laura. We need more time for the video. — Sorry to {3} (interrupt), but the client changed the date yesterday. It's April 26 now. — What do you {4} (mean) by 'changed'? Is it official? — Yes. So, {5} (why / not / we) ask for a smaller first phase? — Good idea. I {6} (will / write) to the client today. — And I {7} (will / send) the new timeline {8} (a más tardar) Friday.
ejercicios.explica: I think abre la opinión; I agree sin am. Sorry to interrupt, but… para entrar. What do you mean by…? para aclarar. Why don't we…? con don't antes de we. I'll + verbo base para comprometerte, y by Friday = a más tardar el viernes.

ejercicios.instruccion: Elige la forma correcta. Es el final de una reunión de equipo: opinar, estar en desacuerdo con suavidad, aclarar, proponer y cerrar.
ejercicios.texto: — {1} the second route is the strongest. It's clear and simple. — I {2}. The client will understand it in five seconds. — I see your point, {3} I'm not sure the client will like the colors. — {4} by 'the colors'? The yellow? — Exactly. — {5} show both versions, one in yellow and one in blue? — Good idea. Laura, can you prepare them? — Sure. {6} the deck by Wednesday. — Perfect. {7}: Laura sends the deck, Andrés prepares the mockups, and {8} the client to confirm the meeting.
ejercicios.explica: In my opinion (no for my opinion). I agree, sin be. I see your point, but… What do you mean by…? Why don't we…? I'll send / I'll call para prometer (nunca will to). Para cerrar: To sum up, no in resume.

ejercicios.instruccion: Completa el email de próximos pasos que se envía después de una reunión. Las promesas van con will + verbo base y las fechas límite con by.
ejercicios.texto: Hi all, thanks for the meeting today. {1} (para resumir), we agreed on three things. First, the launch moves to May 10. Second, the client {2} (agree, pasado) to a smaller first phase. Third, we need new mockups. Next steps: Laura {3} (will / send) the updated deck {4} (a más tardar) Wednesday. Andrés {5} (will / prepare) three mockups for the videos. I {6} (will / call) Sarah on Thursday to confirm the budget. If you {7} (no estar de acuerdo) with something, please tell me today. Let me know if you have any {8} (preguntas). Best, Jonathan
ejercicios.explica: El email de próximos pasos es fórmula: To sum up → lo acordado (the client agreed) → quién + will + verbo base + by + fecha. No estar de acuerdo es don't agree o disagree, nunca «are not agree». Any questions, en plural.

ejercicios.titulo: The meeting where I spoke up
ejercicios.texto: For months, I stayed quiet in the Monday meeting with our client in Miami. I understood almost everything, but I didn't know how to enter the conversation. Last Monday I tried three phrases. When Mike said the budget was too high, I said, 'Sorry to interrupt, but can I just add something? I see your point, but the video is the most important part.' Then Sarah used the word 'scope' and I asked, 'What do you mean by scope?' At the end, I said, 'I'll send you a new proposal by Friday.' After the call, my boss sent me a message: 'Great job today.'

preguntas.q: Why did he stay quiet before?
opciones: He didn't know how to enter the conversation

preguntas.q: «What do you mean by scope?»: ¿para qué sirve?
opciones: Para pedir que aclaren una palabra

preguntas.q: «I'll send you a new proposal by Friday»: ¿qué significa by?
opciones: Hasta el viernes, todo el tiempo

ejercicios.explica: Tres frases bastan para dejar de estar callado: Sorry to interrupt, but… (entrar), I see your point, but… (disentir), What do you mean by…? (aclarar). Y para cerrar, I'll + verbo + by + fecha.

ejercicios.texto: Kickoff notes, coffee campaign. Attendees: Sarah, Mike, Laura and Jonathan. Sarah opened the meeting and explained the goal: more sales in Colombia among people under 30. Mike thinks TikTok is the main channel. Laura agreed, but she suggested a test first: 'Why don't we try three videos before we spend the full budget?' Everybody agreed. Jonathan didn't agree with the timeline: 'I understand the urgency, but six weeks is too short for production.' Sarah said she'll check with her boss. Next steps: Laura will send three video ideas by Tuesday. Sarah will confirm the timeline by Friday. Jonathan will share the budget next Monday.

preguntas.q: What will Sarah do by Friday?
«Jonathan didn't agree with the timeline»: ¿cuál es el error típico del hispanohablante?
opciones: Jonathan wasn't agree with the timeline.

preguntas.q: «Why don't we try three videos…?»: ¿qué hace esta frase?

ejercicios.explica: Un acta tiene la misma estructura que la reunión: opiniones (thinks), acuerdo (agreed, nunca was agree), desacuerdo suave (I understand…, but…), propuesta (Why don't we…?) y próximos pasos con will + by.

ejercicios.consigna: Acabas de terminar una reunión con una clienta. Escríbele el email de próximos pasos: resume lo acordado, di quién hace qué y con qué fecha, e incluye tu propio compromiso.

requisitos.texto: Resume con To sum up o We agreed
Comprométete con I'll / I will + verbo
Pon una fecha límite con by + día

ejercicios.ejemplo: Hi Sarah, thanks for your time today. To sum up, we agreed to launch the campaign on May 10 with a smaller first phase. Next steps: Laura will send the updated deck by Wednesday, and Andrés will prepare three mockups for the videos. I'll call you on Thursday to confirm the budget, and I will share the final timeline by Friday. Let me know if I missed anything. Best regards, Jonathan
ejercicios.explica: El email de próximos pasos se arma con piezas: To sum up / We agreed para el resumen, Next steps para la lista, persona + will + verbo base para cada tarea y by + día para la fecha límite.
